entities.summary: The subtropical zones or subtropics are geographical and climate zones immediately to the north and south of the tropics. Geographically part of the temperate zones of both hemispheres, they cover the middle latitudes from 23°26′09.2″ (or 23.43588°) to approximately 35° to 40° north and south. The horse latitudes lie within this range.
